# How does at-home nail care affect salons?

An open question probing how far DIY **nail** systems erode salon revenue.

## Working answer

Per [[At-Home Nail Care Disruption]], the pressure is asymmetric: it erodes the
basic-manicure tier of [[Nail Care Market Segmentation]] but not the
technician-dependent enhancement tier.

> [!gap] The magnitude of migrated basic-manicure volume remains unmeasured.
